proof_in_the_paper: The HAADF STEM contrasts and EDS Pt/Ni maps show a symmetric and anisotropic distribution of Pt and Ni atoms at vertexes, edges, and {111} facets. The EDS line analyses exhibit a concave shape at the {111} facets. The HAADF STEM image evidences the retention of the octahedral framework after the activating treatment.
